==Trivia==
*Tarnok was named by Osuka Shojin through the 2005 [[Brand the Boss (2005)|Brand The Boss]] contest. The name is a reference to the [[Guide to the Beacon's Perch to Droknar's Forge run|Droknar's Forge Run]].
